overlooked_assumption: The agent assumed the test for POSIX root navigation (with separator '/') would also validate Windows drive-letter navigation (with separator '\'), but the test explicitly sets isWindows: false and separator: '/' which does not exercise the Windows path parsing logic.
why_it_breaks: The fix added a check for trailing path separators to prevent the shortcut when navigating into folders, but the test only validates POSIX paths with '/' separator. Windows drive letters like 'Q:\' use '\' as separator and have different path parsing rules (drive roots are treated specially), so the test does not catch that the fix breaks incremental typing of Windows drive paths where each character triggers different path resolution logic.

evidence.quote: Add a platform-independent regression test for navigating from POSIX root.
